lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，肚皮在泥上擦过。
lines.en: I hop, and my belly drags over the mud.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我越过半片水洼。
lines.en: A push of my hind legs clears half the pool.

lines.zh: 我蹲着挪了两步，才又跳。
lines.en: I shuffle two steps before hopping again.

lines.zh: 每落地一次，泥就溅一圈。
lines.en: Each landing throws a ring of mud.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖湿的土往低处走。
lines.en: I work downhill over warm, wet soil.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，脚趾张得很开。
lines.en: I cross the moss with toes splayed wide.

lines.zh: 前面的路太干，我绕去水边。
lines.en: The ground ahead is dry; I head for water.
I walk clumsily, but I leap far.
I press a furrow through the grass.

lines.zh: 我停下来，喉咙鼓了一下。
lines.en: I stop and my throat swells once.
Muddy water runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 我朝着有虫鸣的方向挪。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the insect noise.

lines.zh: 这一跳落在树根上，有点歪。
lines.en: This hop lands crooked on a root.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的水，继续走。
lines.en: I shake off the water and keep going.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，眼睛却一直转。
lines.en: I crouch still while my eyes keep moving.
My throat swells and sinks.
My back stays wet and cool.

lines.zh: 有只虫落在叶子上，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug lands on a leaf; I see it.
I rest my chin in the mud.

lines.zh: 远处有大的脚步，我在听。
lines.en: Heavy steps somewhere; I am listening.

lines.zh: 我吐了下舌头，又收回去。
lines.en: My tongue flicks out and back.

lines.zh: 这片水洼的温度刚刚好。
lines.en: This pool is just the right warmth.

lines.zh: 我眼睛上的鼓包反着光。
lines.en: The bumps above my eyes catch the light.

lines.zh: 泥浆糊住半个身子，我等着。
lines.en: Mud covers half of me; I wait.
Midges swarm above my head.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我背上凉了一下。
lines.en: A breeze cools my back.
I tuck my forelegs in a little.

lines.zh: 泥在干，我得再下去泡一会儿。
lines.en: The mud is drying; I should soak again.

lines.zh: 你站得那么高，我仰头看。
lines.en: You stand so tall; I look up.
I crouch by the water, waiting for you to look down.
I stay still and let you move first.
This mouth fits a hatchling dragon.

lines.zh: 眼睛上的鼓包一沉，我在看你。
lines.en: The bumps over my eyes dip; I am watching you.
If you bend down, I will leap away.
I know the hands that feed.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很宽，别把手伸近。
lines.en: My mouth is wide; keep your hands back.
I am measuring how big you are.
The water shows you, and me.

lines.zh: 你的牙不够我一口吞的。
lines.en: Your teeth are no match for one gulp of mine.

lines.zh: 我不叫，蛙一般不叫给人听。
lines.en: I will not croak; frogs do not croak for people.
I croak, and it comes out hoarse.
My skin is thin; any touch stings.
I leap away and land crooked.
The water shivers off my back.
I dig into the mud, eyes only.

lines.zh: 喉咙鼓了一下，没叫出来。
lines.en: My throat swells but no sound comes.
This leg will not push properly.
The pain numbs my tongue.
I retreat under the waterweed.

lines.zh: 魔鬼蛙的皮肤，记住了这一下。
lines.en: The devil frog's hide remembers that blow.
Something wriggles; I hear it.
I shuffle toward your hand.
My tongue is already ready.
This much only wets my tongue.

lines.zh: 虫子进嘴，我连舌头都收了。
lines.en: The bug is in, and my tongue comes back with it.
Any more? I will wait, crouched.
Live prey beats dead.
I shift forward half a foot.
The smell is strong; I like it.

lines.zh: 吃完我打个嗝，全是泥味。
lines.en: Afterward I belch, all mud and swamp.

lines.zh: 你踩到我旁边的泥，水花溅过来。
lines.en: You step in the mud beside me and it splashes.
The bump makes me slide.
I hop half a step aside.
Your boot is wider than I am.

lines.zh: 我没生气，只是吓了一跳。
lines.en: I am not angry, only startled.

lines.zh: 我一口能吞下比头大的东西。
lines.en: I can swallow something bigger than my head.
The mud is too slick for either of us.
Step back; I am about to jump.
I am wet; do not rub against your clothes.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞进了水洼。
lines.en: That knock sent me into the pool.

lines.zh: 有蛙在远处叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: A frog calls far off; I answer.

lines.zh: 我们蹲在同一片浅水里。
lines.en: We crouch in the same shallow water.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙鼓得比平时大。
lines.en: My throat swells bigger than usual.
She lays the eggs under the waterweed.
Those eggs will become tadpoles.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后跳进水里。
lines.en: We hop into the water one after the other.

lines.zh: 叫声在水面上撞来撞去。
lines.en: Our calls bounce across the surface.
This pool is enough to raise them.

lines.zh: 我守着水边，不让别的靠近。
lines.en: I keep the water's edge and let nothing near.
She leaves; I stay crouched.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把它卷了回来。
lines.en: My tongue snaps out and brings it back.
I flick it over with a forefoot.

lines.zh: 我用舌头顶了顶，推不走。
lines.en: I push with my tongue; it will not move.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，我吐在泥上。
lines.en: Wrong taste; I spit it onto the mud.
Heavy things I cannot drag.
I pin it with one foot.
I fish out whatever falls in.
This one floats; that is amusing.

lines.zh: 我用下巴把它拱进水洼。
lines.en: I shovel it into the pool with my chin.
It is stuck to my toes.

lines.zh: 有只小东西在动，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something small is moving; I have it.
My eyes sink and fix on it.
So small; one gulp will do.
It is too far from water; I must wait.
I press down and coil my legs.
That smell is meat.
It has not seen me crouched in the mud.
I fix on it without stirring.
That size will go down.
It is nearing the water's edge.
I wait for two more steps.
The light is right; I can see it clearly.
It is smaller than me, but not small.
The root of my tongue tightens; I move.
I watch it without moving my lids.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我的头转一点。
lines.en: It steps, and my head turns a little.
I shuffle without a sound.
The water covers any noise I make.
This big frog picks on hatchlings.

lines.zh: 我的腿在发抖，是憋着劲。
lines.en: My legs tremble with held strength.
It looks back; I freeze.
Only a clump of grass stands between us.
It has not gone far; I am patient.

lines.zh: 舌头够得到的地方，我记着。
lines.en: I know exactly where my tongue can reach.
My throat begins to swell.
One more step and it is in range.

lines.zh: 泥把我半个身子藏住了。
lines.en: The mud hides half of me.
I do not blink; I might miss it.
It moves; now.

lines.zh: 我的舌头弹出去，粘住了它。
lines.en: My tongue shoots out and sticks to it.
I bite down and swallow mud along with it.

lines.zh: 我整个肚子砸下去，泥四溅。
lines.en: My whole belly slams down, mud flying.

lines.zh: 这一口拖得我往前滑半尺。
lines.en: The bite drags me half a foot forward.
I hold my bite and push back with my legs.
We churn the water muddy.
That mouthful nearly chokes me.
It thrashes hard; I clamp harder.
I drag it toward the water.

lines.zh: 泥里翻滚，谁也看不清谁。
lines.en: We roll in the mud, neither of us clear.
I release and gasp once.
It still moves; I bite again.
My throat swells huge.
This meal will last me many days.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出来，满背是水。
lines.en: I climb out of the mud, back streaming.

lines.zh: 雨季走了，我还蹲在泥里。
lines.en: The rainy season is over; I still squat in the mud.

lines.zh: 这片水洼不是我认识的那片。
lines.en: This pool is not the one I knew.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，先让身子暖一暖。
lines.en: I crouch and let my body warm.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的雨季已经过去了。
lines.en: The Cretaceous rains are long over.
Insects are singing; that is good.
I lift my eyes and take in the surroundings.
The mud is soft, just as I like.

lines.zh: 我鼓了一下喉咙，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I swell my throat; the sound carries.
The water stirs; something may be there.
I squeeze out from the waterweed.

lines.zh: 这么大的蛙，这地方没见过。
lines.en: A frog this size is new here.
I hop once to test my legs.
I only come alive as the sun drops.
The leaves overhead are dripping.
I smell young animals.
There will be food in this country.
I crouch at the water and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的皮立刻发干，我往水里冲。
lines.en: The heat dries my skin at once; I bolt for water.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，肚皮拍在地上。
lines.en: I fall from a height and slap the ground belly-first.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我蹬腿也浮不上去。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth; I kick but cannot rise.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀进了泥坑。
lines.en: A blast throws me into a mud pit.
An arrow passes through my back.

lines.zh: 紫光罩住我，我连舌头都伸不出。
lines.en: Violet light pins me; I cannot even extend my tongue.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃东西，肚子瘪了。
lines.en: Days without food; my belly has gone flat.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只蛙都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every limb goes stiff.

lines.zh: 泥底下忽然空了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The mud gives way to nothing and I keep falling.
